title: iCloud Drive metadata
whyItMatters: Which files were in iCloud Drive and when.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy anything you still need from iCloud Drive in Finder to a drive you keep before the local copy is removed.
cleanup.signOut: In System Settings open your Apple Account and turn iCloud Drive off, so this Mac stops syncing the account's files.
steps: Turn iCloud Drive off for this Mac and wait for Finder to finish removing the local copies.
Do not delete the folder named in the plan by hand; macOS manages it, and the full reset at the end clears it.
cleanup.risk: The local iCloud Drive metadata and cached files leave this Mac. The files themselves stay in the Apple Account.
